That active project reviewer satisfies the supplied earlier independent-review prerequisite without becoming an executor. Digest calculation and binding are accepted as Service-provided facts; I did not recompute hashes, execute code, run candidates, or provide human attestation. Approval concerns Gold coherence, not execution readiness or completion of the remaining negative controls.
